user.title: Sign in to SERANOVA
user.description: Use the e-mail and password of your SERANOVA app account. Accounts that sign in with Google or Apple, or that use two-factor authentication, are not supported.

codes.title: Device access codes
codes.description:
IMEI: {imei}

App Key = the device's SERA Cloud Service key (default 123456). User code = your code in the device's user table, the one the SERANOVA app uses. The codes are checked against the device; if the device is asleep the entry is created anyway.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The SERANOVA cloud rejected the stored login for {email}.

reconfigure.title: Login and access codes
reconfigure.description:
IMEI: {imei}

Leave the password or user code empty to keep the current one.

error.two_factor: This account uses two-factor authentication, which the integration cannot complete.
error.captcha: The server asked for a captcha. Sign in once on seranova.eu, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SERANOVA cloud.
error.invalid_app_key: The device rejected this App Key.
error.invalid_user_code: The device rejected this user code.
error.unknown_uid: The cloud does not know this IMEI.

abort.already_configured: This system is already set up.

init.title: Outputs and status polling
init.description: Each enabled output gets a button that pulses it for the given number of seconds (the same as SMS command 022 N#SECONDS#). Polling asks the device for its status so the Online sensor stays current; 0 turns it off. The minimum time between pulses refuses a new pulse that soon after the last one or after any access the device reported: on an open/stop/close gate a second pulse stops or reverses it (0 turns the protection off).

open.name: Pulse output
open.description: Pulses a PROGATE output through the SERANOVA cloud. Success needs the device's own access event. With a response variable it returns success, stage (locked, connect, wake or open), error, acked, confirmed_by and fallback_safe (true only when the output command was never delivered, so an SMS fallback cannot cause a second pulse).

config_entry_id.name: System
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one system is set up.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: Pulse length; defaults to the output's configured length.
